name: Rodel Jr. Ganancial
role: Senior Full-Stack PHP Developer – 7 Years of Experience
tagline: Building web apps with Laravel, React, and TypeScript.
about: I build reliable web applications that solve real business problems. With 7 years of experience across startups, government, and enterprise clients, I specialize in backend architecture, API development, and full-stack delivery. I care about clean, maintainable code and shipping things that actually work.

descriptions.item: Maintained and delivered new features for REX CRM, improving platform reliability for thousands of real estate agents
Integrated third-party services into the platform, extending its capabilities and reducing manual workflows for users
Helped rebuild the white-label casino platform for FBM Emotion, enabling the client to launch a fully branded gaming experience
Integrated third-party game providers into FBM Gaming, expanding the game catalog available to end users
Built the Butterfly streaming platform and its video microservice, enabling scalable short-form video delivery similar to TikTok
Integrated Cloudflare Streaming for chunked uploads and FFMPEG processing, improving video playback performance and reliability
Developed the TG BETS admin panel and mini-game microservice, giving operators full control over casino platform operations
Built a game microservice for third-party game provider integrations, allowing the platform to onboard multiple providers efficiently
Designed and implemented online reporting tools for the FIRMS system, enabling evaluators to track and process fiscal incentive registrations more efficiently
Built dynamic comparative reports that gave stakeholders clear, data-driven insights into registration updates and client status
Developed and enhanced PCB Tracker Online, deployed across all EMB regions to standardize client management and improve operational consistency
Contributed to building the Solid Waste Management System, digitizing 10-year garbage collection plans for LGUs nationwide
Developed the Financial Information System, streamlining budget planning and allocation across all EMB divisions
Provided client support and technical assistance, reducing system downtime and improving user adoption across government offices
Added new modules to the admin panel including car models, brands, and a blog section, expanding the platform's content management capabilities
Built a customer car quotation feature that improved lead capture and helped the dealership convert more inquiries into sales
Resolved bugs and delivered on-call enhancements for the ads module, keeping the platform stable and up-to-date
Built the Fleet & Motorpool Management System for the Presidential Management Staff, centralizing vehicle inventory and maintenance tracking
Integrated the vehicle parts request workflow with the Procurement Management System, eliminating manual hand-offs and speeding up approvals
Built Snap Payroll from the ground up — from database design to deployment — delivering an accurate and reliable payroll solution for multiple clients
Maintained HRIS, DTR, and Payroll systems, ensuring consistent uptime and data accuracy for day-to-day HR operations
Led client onboarding and system deployments, enabling smooth go-lives and reducing setup time for new customers
